blocks.text: A grid is useful when it controls the content, not merely when its lines are visible. The title, paragraphs, captions and images should share deliberate edges.
Reading pages need a stable rhythm. A longer article may repeat its structure across several pages. Page count follows readable text capacity, rather than a fixed template count.
Verify the difficult page with the full source text. If the text does not fit, add a continuation rather than hiding the remainder or shrinking every font.
